title: Jay and his wife Abicene
summary: Gus tells comic stories of Jay going home drunk to his wife Abicene, and of Jay's first and second wives.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: And he used to go home and raise hell with his wife. And I'd take him home. I know he was drunk, we'd get off of work, we'd go by and he'd get drunk and he'd go home and start raising hell with his wife. And I'd say, 'Well, I'm going out,' and he'd say, 'Now, wait a minute, don't leave me, don't leave me.' He'd say some words, and he'd know he shouldn't say them. And if I leave, she's going to jump on him. And he wanted me to stay all night there.
I said, 'No, I'm going home. I'm going to leave you here. You're talking.'
(Laughter.)
That's funny. Did you say he called you 'W'?

Yeah. I don't know why he got that, but he called me "W.W." And he always had different little names for different ones. He'd call me W.W. "Hey, W.W.," one of those things. And then I'd -- I don't know why, but he just give me that name, W.W.
(Laughter.)
That's funny, isn't it?
But his wife, Abicene, she'd run him around the house and he'd be hollering, "Don't you do that, Abicene, stop it, stop it."
(Laughter.)
"Because I'm going to break your head. And I'd say, "There you go again," and she'd get after him again.
Was that -- like, he's told me something. He said that his wife died a few years ago, three years ago or something?
No, she just died a couple of years ago.
That's right.
No, not that one. This was the one before that.
I see, I see.
Yeah.
Yeah, because he intimated but we didn't get into it.
The one that died is the one that had the babies.
That's right, that's right.
The kids.
And then he went back to Kansas City to bring up --
Well, yeah, they --
I don't know whether he meant they were together or not, but --
Oh, he was in Kansas City, but -- because the girls were there.
Yeah. But was he back with her?
No, no, no.
Oh, he just went back. Because he said that he wanted to see that the girls go through school.
That's right.
But they weren't together.
No.
I see. But this is a first one.
That's his first wife, Abicene, yeah.
How funny, that is so funny.
Yeah, he'd get ready to go out and -- 'I'm going in and whup her head this morning.' And know good and well he wasn't going to do a thing.
But he might get his own head whupped.
That's right. I'd say, "You want me to throw your hat in for you?" "Aw, stop that, W., you know good and well she's not going to do anything to me."
(Laughter.)
That's very funny, isn't it?
She used to get on him, though, being drunk. That was why.
